column1: # Rung 1 under CARA risk aversion (2026-10-22; the user chose CARA 0.1 as the
# reference setting). The 10 arms of rung1_partial.tsv plus BANKRUN_CARA=0.1:
# CARA utility, absolute risk aversion 0.1 / mean initial deposit (functions4.jl
# ceValue; pilot_map F12b). r1p showed risk-neutral depositors never split; under
# CARA large ones do. Same seed offset (1000), SEEDING=common and N_INIT=25 as
# r1t-*/r1p-*, so every run pairs with theirs: the same bank, theta and shock.
# Question: do G1', G4', G2a' (and G3, G3c) keep their signs and size (F11)?
# r1c-none also serves rung 4: it is S1's primary arm (no public signal), and its
# exitshape / neighbour / types / wealth files carry S1-S4 (docs/rung4_prereg.md).
